js-mh2-role-permissions.alternative: const allowed=(roles,names,permission)=>{const visited=new Set();function visit(name){if(visited.has(name)||!Object.hasOwn(roles,name))return false;visited.add(name);const role=roles[name];const direct=role.can.includes(permission);const wildcard=role.can.some(rule=>rule.endsWith(":*")&&permission.startsWith(rule.slice(0,-1)));return direct||wildcard||(role.inherits??[]).some(visit);}return names.some(visit);};
